_comment: The prompt disposition vocabulary (#1684): the five shelf labels in shelf order (= the `disposition` computed field's declared option order), the `runnable` field's truthy value, both field keys, and the closed output-handler key set the disposition computation reads. The BACKEND computes the values and owns the vocabulary module (services/project/prompt_disposition.py; options declared in default_schema.py); the frontend names some of these strings in code (promptNodes.ts constants, builtinViews predicates, chatNodes' seed lift) and owns the handler registry (editor-core/outputHandlers.ts OUTPUT_HANDLER_KEYS). Asserted by backend test_prompt_disposition.py AND frontend promptNodes.test.ts so the two sides cannot drift — adding a handler or renaming a shelf must touch this file, which fails whichever side was forgotten.
